projects.title: Enterprise Agentic AI
projects.summary: Production-oriented agent workflows that connect LLM reasoning, enterprise tools, identity controls, and retrieval.
projects.problem: Enterprise users need grounded answers and dependable actions across secure systems.
projects.solution: Architected agent orchestration and secure integration layers using Python, FastAPI, LangGraph, MCP, Google ADK, and cloud services.
projects.impact: Enterprise production engineering, secure tool access, and evaluation-driven release practices.

story.logline: A secure banking AI platform needed to move beyond impressive demos and into dependable production. The mission: give intelligent agents access to the right knowledge and tools without compromising control.
scenes: Enterprise workflows required grounded answers, permission-aware actions and predictable behavior across banking systems.

I engineered agent workflows with LangGraph, Azure OpenAI, enterprise MCP integrations, FastAPI, retrieval and reranking. Evaluation harnesses, policy gates and OpenTelemetry made each release measurable and observable.
The production platform brought secure agent execution, retrieval quality and release discipline together, while model routing and caching improved operating efficiency.

projects.title: Enterprise Knowledge Grounding
projects.summary: Hybrid retrieval and contextual grounding for enterprise knowledge and decision support.
projects.problem: Answers from LLMs require reliable, permission-aware evidence from changing internal knowledge.
projects.solution: Built retrieval workflows with chunking, embeddings, vector search, reranking, grounding evaluation and regression checks.
projects.impact: Grounding, retrieval quality, and observability are first-class engineering concerns.

projects.title: Intelligent Utility Operations
projects.summary: Predictive data pipelines, maintenance knowledge search, and cloud-native automation for utility operations.
projects.problem: Field teams need timely context from operational telemetry, maintenance records and incident reports.
projects.solution: Delivered FastAPI services, Azure AI Search retrieval, streaming telemetry pipelines and AKS deployment automation.
projects.impact: Resume-reported: 65% reduction in technician MTTR; 10M+ daily telemetry events.

story.logline: When utility teams face a field incident, the clock starts ticking. I helped transform fragmented telemetry and decades of maintenance knowledge into faster, grounded operational decisions.
scenes: Field technicians needed actionable context from operational signals, incident history and maintenance runbooks.

I built PySpark and Azure Event Hubs pipelines for telemetry, predictive services, and Azure AI Search-powered retrieval exposed through FastAPI. Docker, AKS and Terraform supported repeatable delivery.
Grounded maintenance knowledge helped teams resolve incidents faster, while automation compressed deployment cycles and distributed processing kept telemetry flowing.

projects.title: SocialWave
projects.summary: An emotionally intelligent AI platform concept and architecture for adaptive conversations and personalized experiences.
projects.problem: Conventional assistants often miss emotional context, memory and nuanced interaction signals.
projects.solution: Designed multi-tier emotion intelligence, situational reasoning, LLM orchestration, memory, human oversight and an API product roadmap.
projects.impact: Founder-led platform architecture and product roadmap. Public demo not yet supplied.

projects.title: FocusAI
projects.summary: AI-powered task prioritization based on urgency, stakeholder impact and dependencies.
projects.problem: Task lists rarely explain what matters most and why.
projects.solution: Designed a React and TypeScript dashboard for AI-assisted priority scores, urgency filters and contextual insights.
projects.impact: UI screenshot and project configuration supplied. Full src folder and working API backend still need verification.

projects.title: Secure AI Platform Services
projects.summary: Cloud-native APIs, event-driven data workflows, security controls and automated quality gates.
projects.problem: Enterprise teams need predictable access to model predictions and governed data services.
projects.solution: Built Python APIs, event workflows, CI/CD testing, OAuth2/JWT/RBAC integration and operational dashboards.
projects.impact: Resume-reported: sub-50ms p95 APIs and 90%+ automated code coverage.

story.logline: Behind every intelligent product is a platform that has to respond quickly, protect data and ship safely. At Forsys, I built the services and delivery foundations that made that possible.
scenes: Enterprise and healthcare workflows needed reliable access to data and model predictions, with robust access controls and repeatable releases.
I developed Python/FastAPI and GraphQL services, event-driven data pipelines and OAuth2/JWT/RBAC controls. Azure DevOps pipelines used pytest, Mocha and Jest to enforce quality gates.
The platform combined low-latency APIs, automated testing and operational visibility, giving engineering teams a stronger base for cloud-native delivery.
